title: beautiful-mermaid is a renderer that actually makes those charts look presentable

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Craft just fixed what everyone hates about mermaid diagrams. Standard mermaid rendering looks kind of dated and theming it means wrestling with CSS classes. Beautiful mermaid gives you stunning SVGs or asy art from the same source. Zero DOM required. Ships with 15 curated themes plus full Sheiki compatibility so you can use any VS Code theme. supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state machines, class diagrams, er diagrams,
